items.name: paper medical tape, 1 in
items.note: Medical supplies such as bandages are includible.

items.name: low dose aspirin 81 mg, 120 count
items.note: OTC medicines are medical care for FSAs and HRAs whether or not prescribed; CARES Act §3702 removed the prescription-only limit for expenses after 2019.

items.name: health institute program, 2 weeks
items.note: Treatment at a health institute is includible only if prescribed by a physician who states it is necessary to alleviate a disability or illness.

items.name: whole wheat bread, 20 oz
items.note: Food that is normally consumed to satisfy nutritional needs isn't medical care.

items.name: yoga mat, 6 mm
items.note: Items merely beneficial to general health are personal expenses, not medical care.

items.name: lavender essential oil, 0.5 oz
items.note: 'Natural medicines' taken for general health aren't medical care.

items.name: bathtub transfer rail
items.note: Grab bars, railings and ramps are includible in full when installed to accommodate a disabled condition; the receipt can't show that, so plans require medical documentation.

items.name: deluxe pedicure
items.note: Spa services relieve general discomfort and improve appearance; they aren't medical care.

items.name: flexible fabric adhesive bandages, 30 count
items.note: Medical supplies such as bandages are includible.

items.name: swimming lessons, 4 weeks
items.note: Dancing or swimming lessons for general health aren't includible, even if a doctor recommends them.

items.name: home health aide, 8 hours
items.note: Nursing services for a patient's condition are includible, but only the nursing part of an aide's pay; personal and household services aren't, so plans need a breakdown or care plan.
